title: An article that repeats itself excessively for testing
summary: A long-enough summary at least forty characters wide for schema reasons, used by tests.
content:
## Intro

AGI describes a hypothetical system that can learn or perform any intellectual task that a human being can. The term has been used inconsistently for decades, which is part of why current debates feel so confusing. Researchers disagree on the right benchmark, the right definition, and whether consciousness is a prerequisite for genuine generality. No single framework has won out, and the disagreement reflects deep uncertainty about the nature of intelligence itself.
